rfi_templates.title: Confirm scope extent
rfi_templates.question_template: Please confirm the extent of {scope_item}, including limits, locations, and exclusions.
rfi_templates.reason_template: The available documents do not clearly define the full extent. This affects quantities, inclusions, and pricing assumptions.

rfi_templates.title: Confirm system and warranty
rfi_templates.question_template: Please confirm the required system, supplier/manufacturer requirements, and warranty period for {trade}.
rfi_templates.reason_template: System and warranty requirements affect specification, BOQ descriptions, testing, and certification allowances.

rfi_templates.title: Confirm heights, levels, and locations
rfi_templates.question_template: Please confirm the applicable heights, levels, locations, and extents for {scope_item}.
rfi_templates.reason_template: The documents do not clearly define where the item applies, which may affect quantity measurement and BOQ breakdown.

rfi_templates.title: Confirm inclusions and exclusions
rfi_templates.question_template: Please confirm whether {scope_item} includes associated trims, accessories, testing, certification, protection, preparation, and making good.
rfi_templates.reason_template: Inclusions and exclusions affect BOQ descriptions and avoid double counting or missing allowances.

rfi_templates.title: Confirm testing / commissioning
rfi_templates.question_template: Please confirm testing, commissioning, certification, and handover requirements for {trade}.
rfi_templates.reason_template: Testing/certification may require separate BOQ allowances or preliminaries.

rfi_templates.title: Confirm drawing/specification conflict
rfi_templates.question_template: Please confirm which document takes precedence for {scope_item}, as the drawings and specification appear inconsistent.
rfi_templates.reason_template: Conflicting documents create quantity, specification, and pricing risk.

rfi_templates.title: Confirm report recommendation inclusion
rfi_templates.question_template: Please confirm whether the consultant report recommendation for {scope_item} is to be included in the BOQ scope.
rfi_templates.reason_template: Consultant report recommendations may not be fully reflected on drawings or schedules.

rfi_templates.title: Confirm testing and commissioning requirements
rfi_templates.question_template: Please confirm testing, commissioning, certification, warranty, and handover requirements for {trade}.
rfi_templates.reason_template: Testing and certification requirements can affect preliminaries, trade scope, and BOQ item descriptions.

rfi_templates.title: Confirm builder/services interface
rfi_templates.question_template: Please confirm whether {scope_item} is Builder scope, Services scope, specialist subcontractor scope, or excluded.
rfi_templates.reason_template: Interface ambiguity can cause duplication, omission, or trade gap risk.
